is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles coluzzii (page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-1014F) and Ace-1 G119S (page 6, 7, 11).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides allele frequencies and sample sizes for kdr and ace-1 across genetic clusters.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Guinea-Bissau (page 9).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study involving field collection and genetic analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies eight localities in Guinea-Bissau (e.g., Quinhamel, Safim, Antula, Mansoa, Mandingará, Ga-Mbana, Comuda, Leibala) (page 3, 9).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections took place between 10th and 30th October 2010 (page 9).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new field collections from 2010.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data is provided in Table 3.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the hybrid zone between Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae in Guinea-Bissau using microsatellites, chromosomal inversions, and whole-genome sequencing. It reports the frequency of kdr (L1014F) and ace-1 (G119S) resistance markers across different genetic clusters.
